subject: Model-estimated annual international migration flows

transformation.sort: estimated_flow_mean descending, then origin_iso3 and destination_iso3 ascending

semantic_guards.estimated_flow_mean: Neural-network model estimate of an annual origin-destination migration flow.
semantic_guards.estimated_flow_std: Standard deviation supplied with the model estimate.
semantic_guards.stock_change: Not present in this fixture and must not be relabelled as a migration flow.
semantic_guards.observed_flow: Not present in this fixture; model estimates must remain visibly qualified.

geography.use: ISO country attributes, continent aggregation, and label-point endpoints for abstract origin-destination arcs

redistribution_notice: The fixture is derived from the GPL-3.0 upstream dataset and remains under GPL-3.0. It is kept in a separate fixture directory and is not relicensed by the repository root license.
